[SWS_CM_10324] Checks for a received SOME/IP event message
⌈
Upon recep-
tion of a SOME/IP event message the checks defined in [SWS_CM_10292] shall
be conducted.
If any of the above checks fails the received SOME/IP event mes-
sage shall be discarded and and the incident shall be logged (if logging is en-
abled for the ara::com implementation).
⌋
